golden_text_response: Arbitration in Texas would not be consistent with Thomas Whitaker's Residency Agreement on the facts provided. The agreement requires all claims and disputes arising from the agreement or from residency, care or services at Magnolia Gardens to be resolved by neutral, binding arbitration, except eviction claims and claims that can be brought in small claims court. It sets Los Angeles, California, as the arbitration location unless the parties mutually agree otherwise. A request from Whitaker's attorney does not by itself establish that agreement, so arbitration in Texas would be consistent with the Residency Agreement only if Magnolia also agrees to change the location.
